newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: C&W names Singapore licence bid partners - TV.
newsitem.headline: C&W names Singapore licence bid partners - TV.

text.p: Cable and Wireless (C&W) has said it will tie up with Hong Kong Telecom, two Singapore companies and possibly one more firm to bid for a licence to operate a full telecoms service in Singapore, state television said on Monday.
State television said C&W would tie up with Keppel Corp, Singapore Press Holdings and Hong Kong Telecom to bid for the licence.
The four are all members of the MobileOne consortium, Singapore's second mobile telephone and pager service, due to start operations on April 1, 1997.
C&W said there might also be another foreign partner, state television reported.
C&W officials in Singapore were not immediately available for comment on the report.
C&W is already on record as saying it would bid for a Singapore licence but had not specified the local partner or partners. Foreign firms must have a 51 percent local partner in pursuing a licence.
Singapore has said it will award up to two additional public basic telecommunication services licences in time to prepare for the launch of commercial services in the year 2000.
Singapore Telecommunications Ltd currently has a monopoly on such service.
